criteria_note: Review kind: shared A-F, G, review-specific R1-R3 and taxonomy X1 scored 0-10. Claims were checked against the arXiv HTML (arxiv.org/html/2501.13956v1, cross-checked with the PDF; the source's own 2.2.2 opening and entity-extraction guideline 6 are truncated in both renders). Outside claims were checked against the LongMemEval (2410.10813) and Leiden (1810.08473) abstracts. Prose length = body chars excluding front matter, headings, code, display math, tables, images and references (inline $$...$$ removed, spaces included).

A.reason: Clear arc from motivation through method to experiments and assessment; front matter complete. Four sentence-shaped '~다' headings break the blog's noun-phrase convention: L215 '### 엣지 무효화: 지우지 않고 끝난 시각을 적는다', L260 '### 새 엔티티는 이웃 다수의 커뮤니티로 들어간다', L425 '### 주요 결과: 정확도는 오르고 컨텍스트와 지연 시간은 줄어든다', L444 '### 질문 유형별로 보면 이득이 고르지 않다'. L35 is a question-shaped H2.

B.reason: Natural Korean in a steady 입니다 register. Some noun frames and filler: L343 '최근 대화를 검색에 끌어들인다는 점입니다' (rewrite: '...끌어들이는 것이 BFS의 장점입니다'); L475 '썼다는 점, ... 않았다는 점, ... 필요하다는 점도 남아 있습니다' (rewrite as a list of gaps); six '할 수 있습니다', e.g. L57 '엣지마다 속성을 따로 붙일 수 있습니다'.

C.reason: Follows the ingestion pipeline step by step, and each section says what feeds into it (L128, L176). Seams: L290 defines the symbols only after the formula at L287; L457 moves the omitted gpt-4o rows into one dense prose sentence, which breaks the comparison.

D.reason: The hard parts get worked examples at the right moment: bi-temporal axes (L103), the four-timestamp Alice walk-through (L207-213), overlap vs non-overlap (L231-236), the BFS seed example (L343), relative vs absolute gains (L436-440). Slight padding for this audience: L51 defines a knowledge graph; L325 explains BM25/IDF.

E.reason: The tables fit: tiers (L61), timestamps (L198), search fields (L329), DMR and LME tables matching the source cell for cell. The per-type table drops four gpt-4o rows and restates them in prose (L457), so readers cannot compare across models in one view. The invalidation formula at L226 is the writer's formalisation, and it is labelled as such (L229).

F.reason: Numbers all match Tables 1-3, and the post separates relative from absolute gains carefully. One unsupported TL;DR claim: L17 'MemGPT 같은 기존 메모리 시스템도 사실이 시간에 따라 바뀌는 과정을 구조적으로 보존하지는 않습니다' (the paper makes no such claim about MemGPT). Invented examples and the overlap formalisation are flagged as examples or interpretation (L99, L229, L246).

G.reason: use_math true with $$ present; description 158 chars, plain text, opens with 'Zep', numbers from TL;DR; no Liquid, fence info 'text'. Minor: 'LongMemEval$$_s$$' (L30, L406) attaches TeX to a word.

R1.reason: Covers every section in depth, including the appendix prompt rules (L134-139, L184-190) and the experimental setup quirks (20 vs 10, L365). It also raises open edge cases the paper leaves unaddressed (T vs T' ordering, L246).

R2.reason: Layers intuition, then formalism, then a numeric example for the bi-temporal model, invalidation and community assignment; the running Alice/Acme/Betacorp example carries through to the context-template line (L319).

R3.reason: TL;DR answers all four questions with model-scoped numbers (L29-31). The closing names concrete gaps (ingestion cost unmeasured L475, message-only experiments, single baseline) and says when to use it (L479); future work comes from the paper's conclusion.

X1.reason: Category is a blog topic; seven tags are a lot, and 'Graph-Based-Retrieval' (L10) is generic. Paper-term tags like 'Bi-Temporal-Model' and 'Edge-Invalidation' are good.

claim headings.evidence: Section headings carry claims (L174 '시간 추출과 엣지 무효화: 바뀐 사실을 지우지 않고 기록하기', L361 'MemGPT를 앞섰지만 너무 쉬운 벤치마크'), but four use sentence '~다' form (L215, L260, L425, L444).

running example.evidence: Alice moving from Acme to Betacorp runs from extraction (L75) through timestamps (L207-213), invalidation (L236), communities (L268) and the context string (L319).

mechanism -> design choice -> formula ->.evidence: Invalidation: problem (L240) -> rule and overlap condition (L221) -> formula (L226) -> Seoul/Busan worked example (L233-236); communities: Leiden vs LPA (L256-258) -> argmax (L265) -> 3-vs-2 example (L268).

facts said once.evidence: Headline numbers repeat in the TL;DR (L29-30), intro (L45), results (L388, L440-442) and closing (L473); the DMR critique is repeated at L473.

numbers with variant, scope and unit.evidence: Every number is tied to a model and benchmark; relative vs absolute is explicit (L434-440, L457 '변화율 열도 모두 상대값').

nothing invented.evidence: Examples are labelled ('날짜 값은 예시', L99; '논문에 없는 설명용 예시', L343) and the overlap formula is flagged as interpretation (L229); one unsupported TL;DR claim about MemGPT (L17).

writer's own assessment at the end.evidence: L473-479: most useful contribution, evidence gaps, unmeasured ingestion cost, when to use or avoid it.

length fitted to difficulty.evidence: About 25k prose chars, which suits a dense systems paper, but trivial background is padded (L51 knowledge-graph definition, L325 BM25).

type-specific shape.evidence: Review TL;DR with four questions, then method, experiments and assessment; no abstract/intro restatement section after TL;DR beyond a short motivation section.

Korean style.evidence: Natural with varied sentence shapes; five '~다는 점' frames (e.g., L343, L475) and sentence headings.

top_issues: Four '~다' sentence headings (L215, L260, L425, L444) plus a question H2 (L35) violate the heading convention.
Unsupported TL;DR claim that MemGPT does not structurally preserve how facts change (L17); the per-type table drops the gpt-4o rows into prose (L457).

A.reason: Noun-phrase headings throughout, no sentence headings, front matter complete. Two H2s open with a single sentence before their H3s (L58 'Zep의 메모리는 ... 구현됩니다.', L331). '### 핵심 결과 요약' (L52) duplicates the TL;DR. Many headings are topic names rather than claims (L60 '형식적 정의', L385 '결과', L353 '재순위화기').

B.reason: Natural, varied Korean with few noun frames: L496 '...줄었다는 점입니다' (rewrite: '...줄었습니다. 실무에서 가장 쓸모 있는 결과입니다'); L486 '원문을 그대로 가지고 있으므로' (rewrite: '원문을 그대로 담고 있으므로'). Register is consistent, including table cells (L205-208).

C.reason: Mostly smooth, but: L46 the GraphRAG paragraph ends abruptly with 'Zep은 시간을 인지하는 동적 지식 그래프 엔진을 사용합니다.', a non sequitur; L181-189 '그래프 구축 프롬프트의 핵심 지침' repeats guidance already given (full names L150, different names L154); L230 '이미 2019년에 닫힌 직장 기록' refers to an example that was never set up.

D.reason: Good help where needed: the MemGPT memory hierarchy (L44), entity-resolution difficulty (L154), the 4-timestamp divergence example (L210), bi- vs cross-encoder (L362), and the relative vs absolute ranking flip (L476-478). Minor over-explanation of IDF (L337).

E.reason: Full per-type tables split by model (L458-474) make cross-model comparison easy; the constructor-field table (L302) and timestamp table (L203) fit the text; all tables match the source cells. The note that the template lacks a community block (L327) is a sharp reading of the visual.

F.reason: Paper numbers all check out, including the sharp observation that the negative-delta rows use the Zep denominator (L480). Three outside-scope inaccuracies: L260 'Leiden ... 연결성 같은 보장은 ... 끝까지 실행했을 때만 성립' (Leiden guarantees connected communities; only subset optimality needs convergence); L236 '그 반대는 일어나지 않습니다' (the paper says only that it prioritises new information); L484/L488 frame the knowledge-update split as 'model size' where the paper says 'more capable models'.

G.reason: use_math true; description 151 chars, opens with 'Zep', numbers from TL;DR, but ends with filler '그래프 구조, 검색 방식, 평가 결과를 정리합니다.'; one bare ``` fence (L312) is acceptable.

R1.reason: Covers every section and the appendix prompts in depth, and adds independent analysis (denominator check L480, abstention category L420, asymmetric latency L433).

R2.reason: Layered explanations with a running Alice/Acme/Globex example, but the walk-through is shallower than it could be: the four timestamps are illustrated by one divergence case (L210), and invalidation shows only the T-axis update (L228).

R3.reason: TL;DR is concrete and model-scoped (L28-30). The closing names ingestion cost, T'-order risk and evaluation gaps (L496-498) and says when to choose Zep (L502). L502 '시간 추론 성능을 따로 확인' misstates the weak spot: gpt-4o-mini's temporal-reasoning actually improved most; it was knowledge-update that dropped.

X1.reason: Category is a blog topic; seven tags; 'Community-Subgraph' is a paper term but not its contribution, and 'Bi-Temporal-Modeling' is fine.

top_issues: Outside-source inaccuracies: Leiden's connectivity guarantee misstated (L260); 'the reverse never happens' overstates the newest-wins rule (L236); the knowledge-update split is framed as model size (L484/L488).
Redundancy: the intro '핵심 결과 요약' re-runs the TL;DR (L52-54) and the prompt-guideline list repeats earlier content (L181-189); there are many topic-name headings.

per_criterion.A: Y - noun-phrase headings; X has four sentence headings
per_criterion.B: Y - fewer noun frames, slightly more natural
per_criterion.C: X - fewer seams and repeats than Y's L46/L183/L230
per_criterion.E: Y - full per-model type tables; X drops rows into prose
per_criterion.F: X - one unsupported claim vs one wrong and two unsupported in Y
per_criterion.R2: X - richer four-timestamp and T/T' walk-throughs
per_criterion.R3: X - Y's closing misstates the small-model weak spot (L502)

preference.reason: The two posts are close in coverage, and both get every paper number right and avoid all six human-fix defects. X wins narrowly on factual integrity (F 8 vs 7), on flow and on the depth of its worked examples (the four-timestamp walk-through and the T vs T' ordering edge case). Y wins on heading convention, complete tables and some sharp independent analysis (the negative-delta denominator, the missing community block), but its outside-source errors and repeated content weigh more.
